name: Causal Organism Decreased
plain_language_rule: Predict treatment when Chemical causally affects organism in the decreased direction for activity, activity_or_abundance The pinned descendant closure is biolink:affects, biolink:affects_response_to, biolink:ameliorates_condition, biolink:decreases_response_to, biolink:disrupts, biolink:exacerbates_condition, biolink:has_adverse_event, biolink:has_side_effect, biolink:increases_response_to, biolink:regulates. All more-specific descendants are explicitly excluded, leaving only biolink:affects.; The organism is asserted to cause the disease The pinned descendant closure is biolink:causes.
hypothesis: Decreasing a disease-causing organism is compatible with anti-infective therapy, unlike unsigned association.

nodes.role: Organism asserted to cause the disease
nodes.explanation: Organism asserted to cause the disease.

edges.subject: chemical
edges.explanation: Chemical causally affects organism in the decreased direction for activity, activity_or_abundance The pinned descendant closure is biolink:affects, biolink:affects_response_to, biolink:ameliorates_condition, biolink:decreases_response_to, biolink:disrupts, biolink:exacerbates_condition, biolink:has_adverse_event, biolink:has_side_effect, biolink:increases_response_to, biolink:regulates. All more-specific descendants are explicitly excluded, leaving only biolink:affects.
edges.exclusion_rationale: This arm tests the exact stated relation; response, adverse, treatment, and other more-specific assertions would change its biological meaning.

edges.subject: organism
edges.explanation: The organism is asserted to cause the disease The pinned descendant closure is biolink:causes.

mechanism.rationale: Decreasing a disease-causing organism is compatible with anti-infective therapy, unlike unsigned association. The graph pattern is a hypothesis, not proof of clinical efficacy.

execution.cypher_template: MATCH (chemical:Drug)-[organism_effect:{{relationship_types:organism_effect}}]->(organism:OrganismTaxon) WHERE organism_effect.predicate IN {{predicates:organism_effect}} AND organism_effect.qualified_predicate = "biolink:causes" AND organism_effect.object_direction_qualifier = "decreased" AND organism_effect.object_aspect_qualifier IN ["activity","activity_or_abundance"] MATCH (organism:OrganismTaxon)-[infection:{{relationship_types:infection}}]->(disease:Disease) WHERE infection.predicate IN {{predicates:infection}} RETURN chemical.id AS subject_id,disease.id AS object_id,count(DISTINCT organism) AS support_count

trapi.limitations: Outside TRAPI: organism_effect: discard exact predicates biolink:affects_response_to, biolink:ameliorates_condition, biolink:decreases_response_to, biolink:disrupts, biolink:exacerbates_condition, biolink:has_adverse_event, biolink:has_side_effect, biolink:increases_response_to, biolink:regulates

limitations: Unknown predictions are unlabeled, not known negatives.
Canonical graph identifiers are deduplicated; parallel evidence does not multiply gene support.
Source assertions lack dose, exposure, clinical context, and experimental causal validation.
